headline: Gondola 3A goes before SMART Gondola Advisory Committee on Monday, October 26
blurb: The Gondola Advisory Committee meets virtually on October 26. The main item is a 25-minute informational update on the FTA Capital Investment Program — the federal funding pipeline that the gondola project depends on — presented by Ed Parks and Gavin Poindexter. Amber Blake follows with SMART and partner jurisdiction updates. Miles Graham handles new business and public comment, each allotted five minutes.
